summary: PicPay (NASDAQ: PICS), via its parent PicS N.V., filed a Form 6-K press release announcing completion of its acquisition of Kovr Participações S.A. and subsidiaries, a digital insurance technology company. PicPay acquired 100% of Kovr shares and 53% of Estrutural Corretora's corporate capital, plus a call option on remaining Estrutural quotas. Transaction closed after regulatory approvals from CADE, SUSEP, and Bacen. No financial terms were disclosed. This is a completed acquisition, so the risk-arb angle is limited; watch for integration execution and potential minority buyout of Estrutural.
